fields.System.Title: OUT-101 — Create an order via API
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an integration client, I want to submit a customer order, so that the warehouse can
fulfil it.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a valid customer, products, quantities, and ship-to address, when I post an
  • order, then it is created with status new and its ID returned.
  • - Given the order, then it records required date, priority, and whether partial
  • shipment is allowed.
  • - Given a zero or negative quantity, then it is rejected.
  • - Given an order line, then the product description is snapshotted onto it so later
  • master data changes do not rewrite history.
  • - Given creation succeeds, then outbound.order_received is published.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, masterdata |
| Tables | order, order_line, outbox |
| Risks | Live master data on historical records ([doc 03 §5](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · event assertion |
